context.transcript:
L M
Thank you for attending our product launch event. ® Did you
know that it's never too early for children to start learning
science —and that there's an exciting way to do it? ® Kids all
around the country love Lex, the chemistry board game that's
as much fun as it is educational. What's special about
Lex is that it's been endorsed by the National Teachers'
Association. And now we're offering Lex with free shipping!
Keep in mind, this product will be very popular. ® Visit our
online store at www.lexgames.com to order now.
www.lexamescom#/512E
LESTEZU.
